unit.label: Destinations, distance & errands
unit.title: Visiting Friends & Nearby Shops
unit.description: 11 new words and forms. Visit a friend, describe distance, and find a nearby place to shop or eat.

goal.text: 我今天要和朋友一起吃飯。
goal.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān yào hé péngyǒu yìqǐ chīfàn.
goal.meaning: I am going to have a meal with a friend today.

unit.bookReference: A Course in Contemporary Chinese 1 · Lesson 5, pp. 95–96; Lesson 6, pp. 104–112, 114–115. Original examples and exercises.

lessons.title: Come to My Place
lessons.subtitle: Connect a destination with come or go.

steps.prompt: You are inviting someone to your home, treated as “here.” Which ending fits 你明天到我家__吧？
steps.explanation: 來 points toward the speaker’s chosen here.

steps.prompt: Which says where I am, without saying I am going there?
steps.explanation: 在學校 gives a location. 到學校去 describes going to school.
到 is dào: the destination marker.

lessons.title: Go See a Friend
lessons.subtitle: Use 找 and check a plan.

steps.prompt: Which means “I am going to see a friend”?
steps.explanation: 找朋友 can mean go see a friend. 教 means teach.
到不到 already makes it a yes/no question; do not add 嗎.
找 is zhǎo, with a third tone; it has 扌 on the left.

steps.prompt: How do you pronounce 便 in 方便?
steps.explanation: 方便 is fāngbiàn. The same character has pián in the earlier word 便宜.

steps.prompt: Which asks whether the library is far?
steps.explanation: 遠不遠 asks about distance; 在哪裡 asks location.
遠 is yuǎn, meaning far.

lessons.title: What Is Nearby?
lessons.subtitle: Name the area around a place.

steps.prompt: Which correctly describes a shop as nearby?
steps.explanation: 附近 is a location expression. For a distance description, use 很近.

steps.prompt: In 學校附近有一家餐廳, which place is the reference point?
steps.explanation: 學校 comes before 附近; the restaurant is near the school.
附 is fù, the first character of 附近.

lessons.title: Buy Things at a Shop
lessons.subtitle: Use 商店 and 東西 in a practical errand.

steps.prompt: What does 買東西 mean here?
steps.explanation: 東西 dōngxi is the everyday noun things.

steps.prompt: Which question asks where you buy things?
steps.explanation: 在哪裡 asks the place where the shopping happens.
商 is shāng: the first character in 商店.

steps.prompt: Does 吃飯 always say that the meal is rice?
options: No, it can simply mean have a meal.
steps.answer: No, it can simply mean have a meal.
steps.explanation: 吃飯 often names the meal activity without specifying the food.

steps.prompt: A friend asks what is near the school. Which answer gives that information?
steps.explanation: The location-first 有 sentence says what exists near the school.

lessons.title: Plan a Small Outing
lessons.subtitle: Recall destinations, distance, places and activities.

steps.prompt: Someone asks 你明天到不到我家來？ You plan to come. Which reply answers the question?
steps.explanation: From the invited person’s viewpoint, movement to the other person’s home is 去.

steps.prompt: Read: 學校很遠，可是我家附近有一家商店。 Which place is stated to be near my home?
steps.explanation: 我家附近有一家商店 introduces a shop near my home.

steps.prompt: Which correctly says the shop is not near?
steps.explanation: Use 不 with the distance description 近.

到.note: 到 dào marks the destination in 到學校去: go to school. It does not by itself mark a completed arrival.
到.memory: Remember 到 as 至 + 刂: a broad left block beside two slim upright strokes.

parts.label: 至
parts.name: left part
parts.description: 至 forms the left block; notice the 土 shape at its bottom.

parts.label: 刂
parts.name: knife component
parts.description: 刂 forms the right edge: a short vertical followed by a longer vertical hook.

朋.note: 朋 is the first character of 朋友. Learn the complete word for a friend.
朋.memory: Two 月-shaped blocks stand side by side: a pair to remember 朋.

parts.label: 月
parts.name: left moon-shaped block
parts.description: The left 月-shaped block is narrow, with two short interior bars.

parts.label: 月
parts.name: right moon-shaped block
parts.description: A second 月-shaped block stands on the right; keep both bases aligned.

友.note: 友 is the second character of 朋友, with third-tone yǒu.
友.memory: A slanting upper arm crosses above 又: remember the meeting strokes in 友.

parts.label: 𠂇
parts.name: upper crossing strokes
parts.description: A horizontal and a long left-falling stroke form the upper frame.

parts.label: 又
parts.name: lower hand-shaped part
parts.description: 又 sits below the frame; its crossing diagonals spread toward the lower corners.

找.note: 找 can mean look for something or go see a person, as in 找朋友. Do not confuse it with 我.
找.memory: A narrow hand 扌 stands beside 戈: reach out to look for someone.

parts.label: 扌
parts.name: hand component
parts.description: 扌 has a horizontal, vertical hook and rising stroke on the left.

parts.label: 戈
parts.name: right crossing component
parts.description: 戈 has a long slanting hook, a crossing left-fall and a small upper dot.

遠.note: 遠 is the opposite of 近. Both describe distance; they do not need 是 before them.
遠.memory: 袁 inside 辶: look for 土 above 口 in the inner block, then the long wrapping base.

parts.label: 袁
parts.name: inner component
parts.description: 袁 begins with 土 over 口 and ends with spreading lower strokes. Keep the inner block above the base.

parts.label: 辶
parts.name: movement component
parts.description: This is the wrapping movement component also seen in 近. Its final stroke extends below 袁.

近.note: 近 jìn means near or close. Use 很近 for a distance description. Follow the eight-stroke Taiwan form shown here.
近.memory: 斤 sits above the wrapping movement component 辶, whose final stroke sweeps along the bottom.

parts.label: 斤
parts.name: inner component
parts.description: 斤 has a short top slant, a longer left slant, a horizontal stroke, and a vertical.

parts.label: 辶
parts.name: movement component
parts.description: The movement component wraps around the left and bottom of 斤. Its long final stroke supports the whole character.

附.meaning: attach; first character of 附近
附.note: Learn 附 together with 近 as 附近, meaning nearby or the surrounding area.
附.memory: 阝 + 付: a narrow folded left side beside 亻 and 寸 on the right.

parts.label: 阝
parts.name: left mound component
parts.description: The left 阝 has a folded upper stroke, a rounded lower turn, and a long vertical.

parts.label: 付
parts.name: right component
parts.description: 付 contains 亻 beside 寸. Look for the long hook and separate dot in 寸.

東.meaning: east; first character of 東西
東.note: 東 means east on its own. In 東西 dōngxi, learn the whole word meaning things.
東.memory: A central box crossed by a long vertical and spreading lower strokes anchors 東.

parts.label: 一
parts.name: top bar
parts.description: The top horizontal stretches above the central box.

parts.label: 日
parts.name: central box
parts.description: Four strokes make the box and its middle bar; a later vertical crosses through it.

parts.label: 木形
parts.name: crossing and spreading strokes
parts.description: The long vertical passes through the box; the final two strokes spread left and right.

西.meaning: west; second character of 東西
西.note: 西 is xī on its own, but light xi in 東西 dōngxi, things.
西.memory: A wide top bar and an outer box contain two bent inner legs in 西.

parts.label: 外框
parts.name: outer frame
parts.description: The top bar, left edge, folded top-right edge and final bottom stroke surround the inner strokes.

parts.label: 內部
parts.name: inner legs
parts.description: A left-falling stroke and a bent right leg fill the box without crossing.

商.note: 商 refers to commerce. Learn it in 商店 shāngdiàn, shop or store.
商.memory: A dot and bar above two short strokes; below them, a tall outer frame holds a small 口.

parts.label: 亠丷
parts.name: top group
parts.description: A dot sits above a long horizontal line, followed by two short inward strokes.

parts.label: 冏
parts.name: lower frame
parts.description: The outer frame has an open bottom. Inside it, two short strokes sit above the small 口 box.

u19-friends.title: A word for a friend
u19-friends.pattern: 我的 / 你的 + 朋友
u19-friends.explanation: 朋友 péngyǒu means friend. Use the whole two-character word. 我的朋友 is my friend; 一個朋友 is one friend. You can also say 我朋友 for my friend in familiar conversation. We keep 的 in most examples here.
u19-friends.remember: 朋 and 友 belong together in the everyday word 朋友.

u19-destination.title: Where the movement leads
u19-destination.pattern: person + (time) + 到 + destination + 來 / 去
u19-destination.explanation: 到 dào marks the destination. In 到我家來, 到我家 names the place and 來 says come toward me or the place I am treating as here. 去 says go away from that viewpoint. This pattern describes movement; 在 describes a location. 到 in these plans does not by itself say that arrival has already happened.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān dào wǒ jiā lái ba!

examples.meaning: I am going to school tomorrow.

u19-destination.remember: Keep the destination between 到 and 來 or 去. Time goes before 到.

u19-find.title: Looking for or visiting someone
u19-find.explanation: 找 zhǎo means look for. With a person it can also mean go see or meet that person, as in 去找朋友. The context tells you whether you are searching or paying a visit. 找 by itself does not guarantee a successful search.

examples.meaning: I am going to see a friend.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhǎo wǒ de shū.
examples.meaning: I want to look for my book.

u19-find.remember: For our visit plans, use 去找 + person. Do not translate 找 automatically as a successful find.

u19-not-going.title: A negative destination plan
u19-not-going.pattern: person + 不到 + place + 來 / 去
u19-not-going.explanation: In the destination pattern just learned, place 不 before 到: 不到我家來 means not come to my home. Before fourth-tone dào, 不 is pronounced bú. This is a negative plan, not “cannot reach”; the latter is a different pattern.

examples.pinyin: Tā míngtiān bú dào wǒ jiā lái.
examples.meaning: He is not coming to my home tomorrow.

u19-not-going.remember: Negate the destination phrase with 不到; keep the final 來 or 去.

u19-destination-question.title: Ask whether the visit will happen
u19-destination-question.pattern: person + 到不到 + destination + 來 / 去？
u19-destination-question.explanation: 到不到 offers the two possibilities, 到 and 不到, as a yes/no question. Say dào bu dào, with light bu in this question pattern. Do not add 嗎 to the same A-not-A question. A 嗎 question is also possible: 你到我家來嗎？

examples.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān dào bu dào wǒ jiā lái?
examples.meaning: Are you coming to my home tomorrow?

u19-destination-question.remember: 到不到 is a yes/no question about this visit; it is not a question asking which place.

u19-near-far.title: Two distance descriptions
u19-near-far.pattern: place + 很 + 遠 / 近; place + 不 + 遠 / 近
u19-near-far.explanation: 遠 yuǎn means far and 近 jìn means near. The reference point is understood from the situation. Describe the place directly: 學校很遠. Do not insert 是 before 很遠. 不遠 means not far; 不近 means not near. In the latter, say bú jìn.
u19-near-far.remember: 很 joins the description naturally; it does not always mean an emphatic “very.”

u19-distance-question.title: Ask about distance
u19-distance-question.pattern: place + 遠不遠 / 近不近？
u19-distance-question.explanation: Ask 遠不遠 to check whether somewhere is far, or 近不近 to check whether it is near. These A-not-A questions do not need 很 or 嗎. You can answer 不遠, 很近, or 有一點遠, using the mild description from Unit 16.
u19-distance-question.remember: A short distance question assumes that the listener understands the reference point.

u19-convenient.title: Convenience is more than distance
u19-convenient.explanation: 方便 fāngbiàn means convenient. The second character is biàn here, unlike pián in 便宜. A nearby shop can make shopping convenient, but convenience and distance are different ideas. Use 不方便 for inconvenient.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng hěn jìn, hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.meaning: This restaurant is near and convenient.

u19-convenient.remember: 方 and 便 are familiar characters, but 方便 is a genuinely new word.

u19-nearby.title: Nearby is a location expression
u19-nearby.explanation: 附近 fùjìn names the area near a reference point. 學校附近 means near the school. Say 店在學校附近 for the shop’s location. If the reference point is already obvious, 在附近 means nearby. 近 describes distance; 附近 names an area, so do not say 很附近.

examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn zài xuéxiào fùjìn.
examples.meaning: That shop is near the school.

u19-nearby.remember: Put the reference place before 附近, following the location pattern from Unit 18.

u19-nearby-there-is.title: Say what is in that area
u19-nearby-there-is.pattern: place + 附近 + 有 / 沒有 + thing
u19-nearby-there-is.explanation: Reuse the location-first 有 pattern. 學校附近有一家餐廳 introduces a restaurant near school. The negative is 沒有. Ask 學校附近有沒有餐廳？ to find out whether any restaurant is there.

examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào fùjìn yǒu yì jiā cāntīng.
examples.meaning: There is a restaurant near the school.

u19-nearby-there-is.remember: Use 在 to locate a known place; use 有 to introduce what exists in an area.

u19-things.title: A word for things
u19-things.explanation: 東西 dōngxi means things or stuff. The second syllable is light xi in this word. Individually 東 and 西 refer to east and west; 東西 with this meaning is learned as one word. 買東西 means buy things or shop.

examples.meaning: I want to buy some things.

u19-things.remember: Say dōngxi for things, not two stressed direction words.

u19-store.title: A shop for everyday errands
u19-store.pattern: 商店; 在商店 + 買東西
u19-store.explanation: 商店 shāngdiàn means shop or store. You already know 店. 商 adds the idea of commerce; learn 商店 as a complete noun. Use 家 to count shops: 一家商店. Place 在 + location before the activity, as in Unit 18.

examples.meaning: I buy things at a shop.

u19-store.remember: 商店 is a place; 買東西 is an activity.

u19-meal.title: Have a meal
u19-meal.explanation: 吃飯 chīfàn often means have a meal, not specifically eat rice. You already know both characters. 去餐廳吃飯 means go to a restaurant to have a meal. 在餐廳吃飯 says where the meal happens.

examples.meaning: Let’s go to a restaurant for a meal!

u19-meal.remember: The food can be noodles or other dishes; 吃飯 is the general meal activity.

u19-really.title: Confirm that a comment is true
u19-really.explanation: 真的 zhēnde means really or truly and confirms the following comment. You know 真 before descriptions, as in 真好吃. 真的 can emphasize a fuller comment: 真的很方便. In 真的, 的 is part of this expression, not the possession marker.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn zhēnde hěn fāngbiàn.

u19-really.remember: Keep 的 light in zhēnde. Do not read this 的 as belonging to someone.

u19-invite.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān dào wǒ jiā lái ba!

u19-see-friend.meaning: I am going to see a friend.

u19-visit-question.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān dào bu dào wǒ jiā lái?
u19-visit-question.meaning: Are you coming to my home tomorrow?

u19-not-coming.pinyin: Tā míngtiān bú dào wǒ jiā lái.
u19-not-coming.meaning: He is not coming to my home tomorrow.

u19-convenient.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng hěn jìn, hěn fāngbiàn.
u19-convenient.meaning: This restaurant is near and convenient.
u19-convenient.note: The two comments follow the restaurant; the comma separates them.

u19-shop-location.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn zài xuéxiào fùjìn.
u19-shop-location.meaning: That shop is near the school.

u19-nearby-food.pinyin: Xuéxiào fùjìn yǒu yì jiā cāntīng.
u19-nearby-food.meaning: There is a restaurant near the school.

u19-nearby-question.meaning: Are there any restaurants near the school?

u19-shop-errand.meaning: I buy things at a shop.

u19-store-near-school.pinyin: Xuéxiào fùjìn yǒu yì jiā shāngdiàn.
u19-store-near-school.meaning: There is a shop near the school.

u19-meal-plan.meaning: Let’s go to a restaurant for a meal!

u19-really-near.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn zhēnde hěn jìn.

u19-friend-meal.text: 我今天要和朋友一起吃飯。
u19-friend-meal.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān yào hé péngyǒu yìqǐ chīfàn.
u19-friend-meal.meaning: I am going to have a meal with a friend today.

u19-reason-plan.text: 那家餐廳很近，所以我們想去吃飯。
u19-reason-plan.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng hěn jìn, suǒyǐ wǒmen xiǎng qù chīfàn.
u19-reason-plan.meaning: That restaurant is near, so we want to go there for a meal.
u19-reason-plan.note: The reason comes before 所以, as in Unit 16.
